ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixel coverage localized in scattered mottling and distinct scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is low-intensity dark gray. High-intensity contiguous white patch located on the upper lateral margin of the right lobe. Diffuse white speckling and circular spots distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible U-shaped depression with an estimated aperture of 70-80 degrees at the central convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge. Right lobe distal tip exhibits increased irregularity and deeper pixel-valleys compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a broad convex curvature from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (0.5-2% total area) scattered across the ventral surface, particularly concentrated on the medial right lobe and lower left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 3-4 parallel, high-intensity linear marks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the central-lateral region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged erosion and possible tissue loss on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical-diagonal rake marks on the left lobe provide a highly unique high-contrast identifier.
